name: suite-env-prefix-refused
body: Two limits. (1) Env-prefixed suite commands (APG_SUITE_E2E=1 bun test ...) are refused by the implementer's shell grant, so an ad-hoc opt-in suite run must either use Bun's automatic .env autoload in opencode-suite/ or, preferably, the gate script (scripts/gate.sh --e2e), which exports APG_SUITE_E2E itself. Limit: a one-off opt-in suite case cannot be run with a direct env-prefixed invocation, and because the gate runs the boundary e2e only after the cargo e2e tier, any cargo-e2e failure aborts the gate before that step — the end-of-run summary lists it as `not run` — leaving the boundary e2e unexercised with no independent entry point. Upgrade when the shell grant admits env-prefixed commands (obsoleting the .env workaround) or when a gate flag runs only the suite e2e. (2) The shell syntax-check step chooses its checker from each script's first line and recognises exactly `#!/bin/sh` (sh -n) and `#!/bin/bash` / `#!/usr/bin/env bash` (bash -n); any other shebang fails the step. Limit: adding install.sh or a scripts/*.sh with another shebang (e.g. `#!/usr/bin/env sh`) turns the gate red until a case is added. Upgrade by adding that shebang's case to the step when such a script is introduced.
